init.label: Personal Finance dashboard
init.body:
# Your money, as a graph
Three CSVs (transactions, accounts, budgets) flow in from the repo at left; everything to the right is **computed live**. Drag any slider and the pivots, gauges, projections and alerts recompute. Each group ships its headline numbers through a **Conduit** as one **Ribbon** into the Dashboard. Click a **Display** chip to inspect a table; **Ctrl+/** opens the function reference.

init.label: 1 · Data sources
init.body:
# Live from the repo
Each **Web Source** pulls a CSV and types every column automatically. It stores the URL, not the data; **Data ▸ Refresh** re-pulls. Desktop can read a local file via the **CSV File** node.

init.label: 2 · Cash flow this quarter
init.body:
# Income vs. expenses
**Filter** the Amount column twice, `> 0` for income and `< 0` for spend, then fold each slice with a **REDUCE** lambda (`acc + x`). Excel: SUMIF. **Savings rate** = net ÷ income drives a gauge and an alert; drag the target slider to trip it.

init.label: 3 · Spending pivot
init.body:
# Group By as a pivot table
A **Slicer** drops the income rows, then **Group By** collapses the rest to one row per **Category**, summing the absolute spend. A second Group By counts transactions. Totals feed a **Chart**.

init.label: 4 · Net worth
init.body:
# Assets − liabilities
Liabilities are stored as negative balances, so net worth is **SUM(Balance)**. Split by sign as in cash flow: **Filter** `> 0` for assets, `< 0` for debt, **REDUCE** each. The split holds in any account order. A **Group By Type** pivot drives the chart; the gauge tracks the goal slider and the alert watches the emergency fund.

init.label: Assumptions (your numbers)
init.body:
# Stray inputs
Hand-entered values that appear in no CSV. They feed the projections and alerts; change one and the right side recomputes.

init.label: 5 · Retirement what-if
init.body:
# Retirement projection
**TVM (FV)** grows today's net worth plus monthly contributions at the assumed return; that is the headline number. The **year-by-year** curve broadcasts the same FV formula across a **SEQUENCE** of years, one Expression over a list, so its last point equals the headline. Drag **Contribution** or **Return** and the projection updates.

init.label: 6 · Mortgage stress-test
init.body:
# Mortgage stress test
**TVM (PMT)** turns a loan, rate and term into a monthly payment; **CUMIPMT** totals lifetime interest. The **Alert** trips when the payment exceeds 28% of take-home pay.

init.label: 7 · Budget vs actual
init.body:
# Spend vs. the Budgets CSV
The **Slicer** keeps the rows for the category you pick (try Groceries), summed into the quarter's spend. The same category's `MonthlyBudget` comes from the **Budgets CSV**, tripled for the quarter; no number is hand-typed. The **Alert** trips the moment spend passes budget.

init.label: 8 · One-glance dashboard
init.body:
# Bundled KPIs arrive as ribbons
The cash-flow, net-worth, mortgage and budget groups each ship their headline numbers through an in-group **Conduit**; the lanes travel together as one **Ribbon** and fan out into these readouts. Click a Conduit to fan its lanes; click a trunk to grab the whole ribbon.
